justification: `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/input/ReversedLinesFileReader.java` is 586 lines and mixes several concerns in one type: a nested `Builder`, a nested `FilePart` that handles block loading/newline scanning/rollover, 7 overloaded constructors, and public APIs for `close()`, `iterator()`, `readLine()`, `readLines(int)`, and `toString(int)`. The dedicated tests in `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/input/ReversedLinesFileReaderSimpleTest.java`, `ReversedLinesFileReaderParamBlockSizeTest.java`, and `ReversedLinesFileReaderParamFileTest.java` exercise many separate behaviors (encodings, block sizes, line iteration, bulk reads, string formatting, filesystem variants), showing the class bundles multiple responsibilities rather than a single cohesive abstraction.
